verdict.rationale: Box documents Collaborations as ACL-like permissions that grant users and groups role-based access on both files and folders, and a community user confirms selectively granting outside parties access to specific files and folders. The evidence never names the actual roles or documents how folder permissions inherit down to subfolders and files. Missing for 10: enumeration of the specific roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner equivalents), documented folder-to-child inheritance behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration of role granularity.
